name: plotnine-stats-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is plotnine, a Python implementation of the grammar of graphics based on
ggplot2: plots are built from data, aesthetic mappings, statistics, scales, position adjustments and facets.
The statistics compute summaries such as counts, bins, densities, boxplot and summary values, smooths, ECDFs
and quantiles; the scales train on the data and map it, with limits, breaks, labels and expansion; the
position adjustments dodge, stack, fill, jitter and nudge; the mapping layer evaluates `aes()` expressions,
`after_stat`, `after_scale` and `stage`; and the facets lay panels out in wraps and grids with labellers.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the plotnine/stats, plotnine/scales, plotnine/positions, plotnine/mapping and plotnine/facets packages (every module under those five directories), together with README.md and the docstrings of those modules (module, class, function and method docstrings, and the attribute docstrings in class bodies).

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is README.md and those
docstrings; in-package code comments are only supporting evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the
documentation, follow the documentation.

The environment runs Pytho
